Streamer of the Week

Streamer of the Week: Xaazon

August 26, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 4:44
Instaread

Streamer of the Week is back! This is where we highlight an awesome LGBTQ+ streamer for you to check out and follow. This week it’s Xaazon!

Every week we ask the same questions, so you are able to get a snapshot of their streaming likes, style and persona. Check out past Streamers of the Week here.

Here’s this week’s quick-fire intro to Xaazon:

Name

Xaazon

Identity & Pronouns

[he/him] LGBTQWA

In my stream community we like to call our larger LGBTQIA+ community the “LGBTQWA” community because there are so many of us that have multiple intersections. So, I am LGBTQWA (the end is pronounced kwah).

What kind of games do you primarily stream?

RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Fighting, Action/Adventure, Cozy

What specific games can your audience expect to see when you stream?

We start every stream with chatting and folding origami, fondly known as origaymi, then we move into a game for a few hours. Minecraft is hands down one of my favorite games to play on or off stream, so expect to see that! We also get into RPG’s like Final Fantasy, Ghost of Tsushima/Yōtei, or some cute simulators like Animal Crossing or Heartopia. And when I’m feeling like I need to pew pew or smash something we’ll get into games like Fortnite or Valheim. Lastly we do community nights where we play Among Us, Peak, REPO, or other fun games that viewers can jump in on.

What’s the most memorable moment you’ve had on stream?

There have been so many. It is truly hard to choose. However one that truly sticks out to me would be when we were having a cheers to the community and someone told us in chat that we were the reason they “still walk on this Earthy plane of existence”. They had been having suicidal idealization, we assume, as they did not say that directly but the context was there. Since then we helped get them into therapy and gave them guidance of places to seek help that were professionals and so on. They are one of my biggest supporters in my community and I appreciate that our community was able to come together to not fix them but to guide them in the right direction.

If you could collaborate with any other streamer, who would it be and why?

I have collabed with streamers over my short one year of streaming and I have loved all of it. One day I am hoping to collab with Idcignacio, VibinwithJazzy808 (again), and of course the PILLAR of our community Pearl the mf Teese!

Idcignacio for his collab events that he puts on. VibinwithJazzy808 because we have so much fun together.
Pearl Teese, well it’s Pearl, need I say more?

What is your favorite game of all time and why?

Favorite game of all time would be Final Fantasy X, although Minecraft has quickly crept up my list. Final Fantasy X is my favorite for the nostalgia but also for the storyline. The way they view religion, sin, faith and how you are not allowed to question it in that world reflects a lot of what we deal with IRL. FFX gives me a place to fight, cry, XP farm, and enjoy a rich story. Speaking of XP farming, the sphere grid alone makes it so you can customize the characters as you want, although they do have their predetermined paths, you can still turn the tank into a white mage or the black mage into a rogue.

How would you describe your streaming style in three words?

Silly. Open. Chatty.

What is your streaming schedule?

S: No Stream
M: 4p PST Minecraft Mundaze
T: 1p PST TT, YT, IG Stream
W: No Stream
T: 1p PST Art Stream
F: 4p PST RPG’s (Currently Horizon Zero Blonde)
S: 1p PST Random/Playtests/Demo’s

Where can people find you?

  • Twitch
  • YouTube
  • Instagram
  • TikTok
  • BlueSky

Anything else you’d like to add?

Although we talk a lot of shit, and are constantly laughing, we are a loving, caring community who has carved a small special place on the internet to enjoy chatting, arts ‘n’ crafts and gayming together.
